source_recovery: Initialize history count before output then input; this recovers the initial load/reset schedule.
Use an ordinary loop-local pointer to the coefficient table base; the row remains an indexed signed-short offset.
Use phase * 64, rather than phase << 6, for the 64-phase table conversion. VC7 emits the original destructive shift/saved-phase schedule.
Cache the output buffer at the start of each output iteration; moving that cache to the store reproduces every byte except the commuted SIB.
Reuse the loop index for the final phase advance, as the independently exact MMX sibling does.
